title_ar: الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء يشارك في مؤتمر السنة النبوية
title_en: Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, Head of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, Takes Part in the Conference on the Prophetic Sunnah
body_ar: شارك الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء في الملتقى الرابع المنظم في ولاية قسطنطينة بالجزائر، تحت عنوان: " السنة النبوية في مواجهة الشبهات والتحديات. افتتح الملتقى يوم الإثنين الموافق ل 11 ابريل 2011، وقد ألقى الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء كلمة الوفود في الجلسة الافتتاحية للملتقى وترأس الجلسة الأولى من جلساته. وفي البرنامج المصاحب للملتقى قدم الشيخ – حفظه الله- في مساء نفس اليوم محاضرة في مسجد الأمير عبد القادر بقسطنطينة بعد صلاة المغرب، كما قدم درسا توجيهيا بعد صلاة العشاء للأئمة في مقر دار الإمام. وكانت جمعية العلماء المسلمين الجزائريين بقسطنطينة قد نظمت حفلا تكريميا للشيخ في مساء نفس اليوم الاثنين. وفي اليوم الثاني من الملتقى ألقى فضيلة الشيخ الددو كلمة في الجلسة الثانية من الفترة المسائية تحت عنوان: "السنة في نظر الحداثيين". وسينشر الموقع – بإذن الله – لاحقا مشاركات الشيخ في هذا الملتقى.لمتابعة كلمة الضيوف :اضعط هنا
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, head of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, took part in the fourth colloquium held in the wilaya of Constantine in Algeria, under the title: "The Prophetic Sunnah in the Face of Doubts and Challenges. The colloquium opened on Monday 11 April 2011, and Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, head of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, delivered the address of the delegations at the colloquium's opening session and chaired the first of its sessions.

In the programme accompanying the colloquium, the Sheikh — may God preserve him — gave a lecture on the evening of the same day at the Emir Abd al-Qadir Mosque in Constantine, after the sunset prayer, and gave a lesson of guidance for the imams after the night prayer at the premises of the House of the Imam. The Association of Algerian Muslim Scholars in Constantine had organised a ceremony in the Sheikh's honour on the evening of that same Monday. On the second day of the colloquium, his eminence Sheikh al-Dedew delivered an address in the second session of the evening period, under the title: "The Sunnah in the View of the Modernists". The site will, God willing, publish the Sheikh's contributions to this colloquium later.

flags.arabic: تحت عنوان: " السنة النبوية في مواجهة الشبهات والتحديات. افتتح الملتقى
options: preserve the unclosed quotation mark as served and let the title run into the next sentence, as the Arabic does
close the quotation at the evident end of the title
flags.note: The opening quotation mark before the colloquium's title is never closed, and the full stop that follows is where the closing mark should be, so the title runs into the next sentence in the served text. The English reproduces the defect rather than tidying it, per style guide section 11. Where the title ends is not in doubt.

flags.context: the title of the Sheikh's second address at the colloquium
options: The Sunnah in the View of the Modernists
The Sunnah as the Modernists See It
The Sunnah in the Eyes of the Modernists
flags.note: 'الحداثيون' names those identified with modernist approaches to the Islamic sources, and is used in Arabic scholarly polemic with a critical edge that 'modernists' in English does not automatically carry. Rendered plainly; only the title is given here and the record contains nothing of the address itself, so the English must not signal any position the record does not report.

flags.arabic: وسينشر الموقع – بإذن الله – لاحقا مشاركات الشيخ في هذا الملتقى
flags.context: the closing promise, which is also made in record 680
options: render exactly, and check whether the promised contributions were published as separate records
flags.note: The same promise appears at the end of record 680 about a different conference. If those contributions were published they would be primary material, where these notices are not, and they may sit elsewhere in the corpus under separate IDs. Worth a targeted check by whoever compiles the finished site.

translator_notes: A short site news notice listing appearances at a conference, not a text by the Sheikh. It records four separate items — the delegations' address, the chairing of a session, a mosque lecture, and a lesson for imams — but contains the content of none of them.
'ابريل' is written without hamza and the day is given both as 'الإثنين' and 'الاثنين' within the same item; both left as served.
The closing navigation line has 'اضعط' for 'اضغط'; it is a site affordance rather than content and is not part of body_ar or body_en.
